people.name: Moab

people.name: Rephaim
people.line: A race of giants who inhabited Canaan

translations.web: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
translations.bsb: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
translations.kjv: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
